summary: For forty days, the giant Goliath shouted challenges at Israel's army, and everyone was afraid. When young David brought food to his brothers, he was shocked that no one would stand up for God.

story_reel.narration: The Philistines and the Israelites lined up for battle on two hills, with a valley in between. Every morning, a giant named Goliath stepped out from the Philistine army. He was over nine feet tall! He wore a bronze helmet and armor that weighed as much as a grown man, and the head of his spear was as heavy as a bowling ball. Goliath shouted, 'Choose a man to fight me! If he wins, we'll be your servants. If I win, you'll be ours!' King Saul and all the Israelites were terrified. For forty days, morning and evening, Goliath shouted his challenge, and no one would face him. Meanwhile, back in Bethlehem, Jesse said to his youngest son, David, 'Take this grain, bread, and cheese to your brothers at the battle, and see how they're doing.' When David arrived, he heard Goliath shouting. All the soldiers ran away in fear. But David asked, 'Who is this man who dares to insult the armies of the living God?' His oldest brother, Eliab, got angry. 'Why did you come here? You just want to watch the battle!' But David kept asking. Everyone else saw how big the giant was. David saw how big God is.

scenes.caption: Goliath

scenes.caption: 'The living God!'
scenes.art_direction: David standing among frightened soldiers, his eyes bright with faith.

memory_verse.text: Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?

identity_focus.core_truth: I can see big problems God's way, remembering how big He is.
identity_focus.reflection_prompt: Everyone else saw how big the giant was. David saw how big God is. What helps you remember how big God is?

quiz.question: How long did Goliath shout his challenge?
quiz.explanation: The Philistine came near morning and evening, and presented himself forty days.

quiz.question: What did Jesse send David to bring his brothers?
quiz.explanation: Jesse sent parched grain, ten loaves, and ten cheeses.

quiz.question: What did David call Israel's army?
options: The armies of the living God
quiz.explanation: David said, 'Who is this Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?'

micro_prayer.text: Yahweh, You are my light and my strength. When I face big problems, help me see them Your way and remember how big You are. Amen.

companion.message: I came to deliver cheese! But when I heard that giant insulting God, something rose up in me. I had seen God protect me before. I knew He was bigger.
